title: One server: a hard ceiling and a single point of failure
caption: DNS hands every user the same address. When that box is full or down, so is the product.

steps.text: The browser or app resolves the hostname and gets back one IP address.
Every request goes to that one machine. Its CPU, memory and connection limit are the product's limit.
Deploy, crash or hardware failure: everyone is down. Scaling up to a bigger box helps for a while, then gets expensive and still fails as one unit.
